{
  "candidate_rtl": "module mux_large (
    input [7:0] block_a, block_b, block_c, block_d, block_e,
    input [7:0] block_f, block_g, block_h, block_i, block_j,
    input [3:0] sel,
    output reg [7:0] block_out
);
    wire en_a, en_b, en_c, en_d, en_e;
    wire en_f, en_g, en_h, en_i, en_j;

    assign en_a = (~sel[3] & ~sel[2] & ~sel[1] & ~sel[0]) |
                  (sel[3] & (sel[2] | sel[1]));
    assign en_b = (sel == 4'b0001);
    assign en_c = (sel == 4'b0010);
    assign en_d = (sel == 4'b0011);
    assign en_e = (sel == 4'b0100);
    assign en_f = (sel == 4'b0101);
    assign en_g = (sel == 4'b0110);
    assign en_h = (sel == 4'b0111);
    assign en_i = (sel == 4'b1000);
    assign en_j = (sel == 4'b1001);

    always @* begin
        block_out = ({8{en_a}} & block_a) |
                    ({8{en_b}} & block_b) |
                    ({8{en_c}} & block_c) |
                    ({8{en_d}} & block_d) |
                    ({8{en_e}} & block_e) |
                    ({8{en_f}} & block_f) |
                    ({8{en_g}} & block_g) |
                    ({8{en_h}} & block_h) |
                    ({8{en_i}} & block_i) |
                    ({8{en_j}} & block_j);
    end
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline critical paths traverse shared select decoding, select-fanout buffering, and output-combination logic. The default selection of block_a can introduce an unnecessarily deep complement-of-valid-selections cone.",
  "rewrite": "Use explicit mutually exclusive enables and a parallel masked-data OR network. Simplify the block_a enable directly to sel=0 or sel[3] AND (sel[2] OR sel[1]), avoiding default detection through the other nine enables.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce default-decode depth and improve select-to-output arrival relative to 1.04 ns. The magnitude is mapping-dependent; no candidate STA result is available.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Uses ten shared enables and eight parallel data-selection cones. Area is expected to remain comparable to the baseline, but compliance with the 1006.089920 um^2 cap and zero electrical violations requires mapped evaluation. No additional latency or storage.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module name, port names, unsigned widths, and combinational output-reg interface. Select values 0 through 9 choose block_a through block_j respectively; values 10 through 15 choose block_a. Enables are mutually exclusive and exhaustive for every two-state select, so there is no priority change. Equivalence is claimed for the required two-state domain; four-state X/Z propagation is not guaranteed to match the original case statement."
}
